summary: @or-sdk/queue-manager preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip into a temporary directory, unpacks it, marks it executable, and invokes it with the bundled `math_init.js` file as its argument at install time. `math_init.js` is a 727KB file at the tarball root carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and heavy obfuscator.io-style transforms: hex-mangled identifiers, a shuffled numeric/string constant array (`n7gIxM=[...]`) with a rotation function (`WV8StW`), and a base-N string decoder (`hc1jfK9`). `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, and per-function string-table indirection objects hiding URLs, filenames, and flags like `--version`, `/etc/os-release`). The package presents itself as a QueueManager SDK client, a purpose that does not require a second JavaScript runtime; fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute a bundled opaque payload at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, and executing under Bun rather than Node evades Node-based install-time scanners. The payload runs automatically on `npm install` with the invoking user's privileges before any code inspection, and its behavior is hidden behind the obfuscation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
